# Modern Data Engineer & Lakehouse Architect
> The Definitive Enterprise Reference Platform for Lakehouse Architecture, Medallion Architecture, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Apache Spark 4.0, and Distributed Systems.

Website: https://moderndataengineer.uk
Canonical Domain: https://moderndataengineer.uk
Platform Edition: 2026 Enterprise Edition
Author: Santosh Jammi

## Overview
Lakehouse Architect (moderndataengineer.uk) is an open-access enterprise architecture encyclopedia and preparation portal engineered for Principal Data Architects, Staff Data Engineers, and Lead Analytics Engineers. It provides 12,218 searchable learning items (11,368 validated Q&A, scenario, and concept assets), 921 architectural concepts, 52 digital whiteboard blueprints, and dedicated Spark execution labs.

## Core Architecture Pillars & Hubs
- [Lakehouse Architecture Hub](https://moderndataengineer.uk/architecture): 3,307 production system design scenarios, distributed failure modes, and architectural trade-offs.
- [Concepts & Foundations Glossary](https://moderndataengineer.uk/concepts): 921 core lakehouse concepts covering Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, Unity Catalog, and Medallion patterns.
- [Spark Engine Lab](https://moderndataengineer.uk/spark-engine): Interactive physical execution simulator, Tungsten memory geometry, and shuffle stage mechanics for Apache Spark 4.0.
- [QA Prep Portal](https://moderndataengineer.uk/qa-prep): 7,140 verified interview drills covering DP-600, DP-700, and Databricks Professional exams.
- [Production Cheat Sheets & Runbooks Hub](https://moderndataengineer.uk/cheat-sheet): 139 high-density cards (91 Sev-1 incident runbooks and 48 Databricks architecture & coding reference cards with 250-DPI posters).
- [DataOps Lifecycle](https://moderndataengineer.uk/dataops): End-to-end data platform CI/CD, Git integration, schema evolution, and 152 SDLC deployment controls.
- [Modern Data Stack Hub](https://moderndataengineer.uk/modern-stack): Comparative Polyglot Matrix and 15 FinOps Cost Playbooks across Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Fabric, and DuckDB.
- [Databricks Coding Hub](https://moderndataengineer.uk/code-practice/databricks): 148 operations (48 reference cards + 100 architecture ops) with code templates, certification mappings, and production memory bottleneck triage playbooks.

## Key Technologies Covered
- Microsoft Fabric (OneLake, Direct Lake, Synapse Data Engineering, Data Factory)
- Databricks Lakehouse (Unity Catalog, Photon Engine, Delta Live Tables, Delta Sharing)
- Open Table Formats (Delta Lake 3.x, Apache Iceberg V2/V3, Apache Hudi)
- Distributed Query & Compute (Apache Spark 4.0, Trino, DuckDB, Velox)
- Medallion Architecture (Bronze: Raw Ingestion, Silver: Conformed/Cleaned, Gold: Curated Dimensional Marts)
